paragraphs: Comcast Corporation, formerly known as Comcast Holdings, is an American multinational mass media, telecommunications, and entertainment conglomerate. Comcast's corporate headquarters is at the Comcast Center in Philadelphia, while NBCUniversal, Comcast's New York operations and other major Comcast assets are headquartered at 30 Rockefeller Plaza in Midtown Manhattan in New York City. The company was ranked 51st in the Forbes Global 2000 in 2023. It is the fourth-largest telecommunications company by worldwide revenue, after AT&T, Verizon, and China Mobile. Comcast is the third-largest pay-TV company, the second-largest cable TV company by subscribers, and the largest home Internet service provider in the United States.

It owns and operates the Xfinity residential cable communications business segment and division; Comcast Business, a commercial services provider; and Xfinity Mobile, an MVNO of Verizon. The company is also the nation's third-largest home telephone service provider, serving residential and commercial customers in 40 states and the District of Columbia.

Comcast has owned NBCUniversal and its various mass media subsidiaries since 2013. It is a high-volume producer of films for theatrical exhibition and television programming through its film studios: Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, Illumination, and Focus Features. Its over-the-air national broadcast network channels include the National Broadcasting Company (NBC, one of America's Big Three television networks), Spanish-language channels Telemundo, TeleXitos, and Universo, television stations like Cozi TV, and pay-TV channel Bravo. NBCUniversal also works in news (NBC News and Noticias Telemundo) and sports (NBC Sports, NBCSN and Telemundo Deportes), bolstered by its 1996 acquisition of professional sports company Spectacor. It owns the video-on-demand streaming service Peacock; its holdings in digital distribution include thePlatform, acquired in 2006; and ad-tech company FreeWheel, acquired in 2014. Comcast has been the parent company of Sky Group since 2018, when it dropped out of the running to buy 21st Century Fox, Sky's then-largest shareholder, and instead acquired the company from Fox and other shareholders. The company also operates theme parks under its Universal Destinations & Experiences subsidiary.

Comcast announced plans on June 29, 2026, to separate NBCUniversal and Sky into an independent publicly traded company through a tax-free spin-off. The proposed transaction would leave Comcast focused on connectivity and technology services, while the new company would contain its media and entertainment businesses. Completion is expected in summer 2027, subject to required approvals and other conditions.

Comcast is criticized and put under intense public scrutiny for a variety of reasons. Its customer satisfaction ratings were among the lowest in the cable industry from 2008 to 2010. It has violated net neutrality practices; it has offered a commitment to a narrow definition of net neutrality that critics say ignores the difference between Comcast's private network services and the rest of the Internet. Critics also note a lack of competition in the vast majority of Comcast's service areas; in particular, the limited competition among cable providers. Given its negotiating power as a large ISP, some suspect that it could use paid peering agreements to unfairly influence end-user connection speeds. Comcast's ownership of both content production (in NBCUniversal) and distribution (as an ISP) has raised antitrust concerns that scuttled the company's 2014 effort to acquire Time Warner Cable. Comcast was dubbed "The Worst Company in America" by The Consumerist in 2010 and 2014.

people.name: Brian L. Roberts
people.title: Chairman and Co-Chief Executive Officer
people.bio: Has served as a director, Chairman of the Board and a Chief Executive Officer for more than five years. Previously served as President until October 2022.
people.quote: Brian L. Roberts has served as a director and as Chairman of the Board and a Chief Executive Officer for more than five years.

people.name: Michael J. Cavanagh
people.title: Co-Chief Executive Officer
people.bio: Became Co-Chief Executive Officer in January 2026 after serving as President since October 2022 and Chief Financial Officer from July 2015 to January 2023. Previously held leadership roles at The Carlyle Group and JPMorgan Chase & Co.
people.quote: Michael J. Cavanagh has served as Co-Chief Executive Officer since January 2026.

people.name: Jason S. Armstrong
people.title: Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: Has served as Chief Financial Officer since January 2023 and previously served as Treasurer, Deputy Chief Financial Officer, Chief Financial Officer of Sky Limited and Senior Vice President of Investor Relations. Joined Comcast in 2014 after spending 14 years at Goldman Sachs.
people.quote: Jason S. Armstrong has served as Chief Financial Officer since January 2023.

people.name: Jennifer Khoury
people.title: Chief Communications Officer
people.bio: Has served as Chief Communications Officer since February 2020 and held other senior positions after joining Comcast in 1999, including Senior Vice President of Corporate and Digital Communications. Previously led communications, public affairs and social responsibility programs for AT&T Broadband and MediaOne and served as a strategic consultant for ML Strategies.
people.quote: Jennifer Khoury has served as Chief Communications Officer since February 2020.

people.name: Thomas J. Reid
people.title: Chief Legal Officer and Secretary
people.bio: Has served as Chief Legal Officer and Secretary since April 2019. Previously served as Chairman and Managing Partner of Davis Polk & Wardwell, a partner at that firm, and a Managing Director in Morgan Stanley's Investment Banking Division.
people.quote: Thomas J. Reid has served as Chief Legal Officer and Secretary since April 2019.

people.name: Brian L. Roberts
people.title: Chair of the Board
people.bio: Roberts serves as Comcast's Chairman and co-CEO and has been a director since March 1988. He provides leadership on strategic initiatives together with Michael J. Cavanagh.
people.quote: Brian L. Roberts, 65 Chairman of the Board, President and CEO Director Since: March 1988

people.name: Kenneth J. Bacon
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Bacon has been a partner at RailField Partners since 2012. He previously served as Executive Vice President of Fannie Mae's multifamily mortgage business from 2005 to 2012.
people.quote: Kenneth J. Bacon, 71 Independent Director Director Since: November 2002

people.name: Thomas J. Baltimore, Jr.
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Baltimore has served as Chairman, President and CEO of Park Hotels & Resorts since 2017. He previously led RLJ Lodging Trust and co-founded RLJ Development.
people.quote: Thomas J. Baltimore, Jr., 62 Independent Director Director Since: March 2023

people.name: Asuka Nakahara
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Nakahara has served as an independent Comcast director since February 2017 and is a member of the Audit Committee.
people.quote: Asuka Nakahara, 70 Independent Director Director Since: February 2017 Committee Membership: Audit Committee

people.name: Wonya Y. Lucas
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Lucas joined Comcast's Board in April 2024 as an independent director and serves on the Audit Committee.
people.quote: Wonya Y. Lucas, 65 Independent Director Director Since: April 2024 Committee Membership: Audit Committee

people.name: Louise F. Brady
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Brady is Co-Founder and Managing Partner of Piedmont Capital Partners, Piedmont Capital Partners II and Piedmont Capital Investments, and previously served as President of Blue Current. Her detailed biography lists age 61 and Compensation and Human Capital membership, used here; an earlier snapshot entry conflicts, listing age 59 and Audit membership.
people.quote: Louise F. Brady, 61 Independent Director Director Since 2023 Compensation and human capital committee

people.name: Jeffrey A. Honickman
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Honickman has served as an independent Comcast director since December 2005. He serves on the Audit and Governance and Corporate Responsibility Committees.
people.quote: Jeffrey A. Honickman, 69 Independent Director Director Since: December 2005

people.name: Edward D. Breen
people.title: Lead Independent Director
people.bio: Breen is Chairman of DuPont de Nemours and previously served as CEO of DuPont, DowDuPont and Tyco International. His current Comcast board service began in 2014, following an earlier term from 2005 to 2011.
people.quote: Edward D. Breen, 70 Lead Independent Director Director Since: February 2014

people.name: Madeline S. Bell
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Bell has served as President and CEO of The Children's Hospital of Philadelphia since 2015, following multiple leadership roles there from 1995 to 2015. She began her career as a pediatric nurse in 1983.
people.quote: Madeline S. Bell, 64 Independent Director Director Since: Februar y 2016

people.name: Gordon Smith
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Smith served as Co-President and Chief Operating Officer of JPMorgan Chase from 2018 to 2022 and CEO of its Consumer and Community Banking business from 2012 to 2021. He previously held various leadership roles at American Express.
people.quote: Gordon smith, 67 Independent Director Director Since January 2026 Committee Membership Audit

people.name: Michael J. Cavanagh
people.title: Co-CEO and Director
people.bio: Cavanagh was elevated to Comcast co-CEO in January 2026. The board snapshot lists his directorship as beginning in January 2026.
people.quote: Michael J. Cavanagh, 60 Co-CEO Director Since: January 2026 Committee Membership: None
